calls.statement: SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_period_label, period_start_date, period_end_date, weeks_in_period, fully_loaded FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' ORDER BY 2

SELECT s.store_id = 900 AS is_web, s.store_id = 999 AS is_999, count(*) AS line_rows, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS dist_line_ids, count(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS dist_receipt_lines, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts, sum(f.net_amount) AS net, sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS staff_lines, min(f.sale_date) mn, max(f.sale_date) mx, count(DISTINCT f.etl_loaded_at) AS loads
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
GROUP BY 1,2

WITH w AS (
 SELECT o.web_order_id, o.status, o.fulfilment_type, o.line_count,
  CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS order_d,
  CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS disp_d
 FROM fact_web_order o)
SELECT status,
  count(*) AS orders,
  sum(CASE WHEN order_d BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS order_in_range,
  sum(CASE WHEN disp_d BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS disp_in_range,
  sum(CASE WHEN order_d BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' AND (disp_d IS NULL OR disp_d NOT BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ordered_in_not_disp_in,
  sum(CASE WHEN disp_d BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' AND order_d NOT BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS disp_in_not_ordered_in,
  (SELECT count(DISTINCT web_order_id) FROM w) AS dist_orders, (SELECT count(*) FROM w) AS rows_all
FROM w GROUP BY status ORDER BY 1

WITH st AS (
 SELECT f.receipt_id, f.sale_date, f.net_amount, f.staff_purchase_flag, s.store_id, p.category,
  CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', f.sale_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS hel_d
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE s.store_id < 900)
SELECT
 (SELECT count(*) FROM st WHERE sale_date<>hel_d) AS date_mismatch_all,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM st WHERE category='ZZ Test') AS test_lines_all,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM st WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' AND store_id<>999 AND category='ZZ Test') AS test_in_range,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id FROM st GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(DISTINCT store_id)>1)) AS receipts_multi_store,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id FROM st GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(DISTINCT staff_purchase_flag)>1)) AS receipts_mixed_staff,
 (SELECT min(net_amount) FROM st) AS min_net,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM st WHERE net_amount<=0) AS nonpos

WITH r AS (
 SELECT CASE WHEN store_id<900 THEN 'stores' WHEN store_id=900 THEN 'web' ELSE 'other' END AS grp,
  sum(receipts) rpt_receipts, sum(net_sales_before_returns) rpt_gross_net
 FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' GROUP BY 1),
f AS (
 SELECT CASE WHEN s.store_id<900 THEN 'stores' WHEN s.store_id=900 THEN 'web' ELSE 'other' END AS grp,
  count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS my_receipts, sum(f.net_amount) AS my_net
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE s.store_id<900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT r.*, f.my_receipts, f.my_net FROM r LEFT JOIN f USING (grp)

WITH wl AS (
 SELECT f.receipt_id, f.net_amount, f.staff_purchase_flag, p.category, o.status,
  CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS disp_d,
  CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS order_d
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
 WHERE s.store_id=900)
SELECT 'dispatch_all' basis, count(DISTINCT receipt_id) receipts, sum(net_amount) net, count(*) lines FROM wl WHERE disp_d BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
UNION ALL SELECT 'dispatch_no_test', count(DISTINCT receipt_id), sum(net_amount), count(*) FROM wl WHERE disp_d BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' AND category<>'ZZ Test'
UNION ALL SELECT 'dispatch_test_only_lines', count(DISTINCT receipt_id), sum(net_amount), count(*) FROM wl WHERE disp_d BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' AND category='ZZ Test'
UNION ALL SELECT 'order_date_no_test', count(DISTINCT receipt_id), sum(net_amount), count(*) FROM wl WHERE order_d BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' AND category<>'ZZ Test'
UNION ALL SELECT 'staff_lines_web', count(DISTINCT receipt_id), sum(net_amount), count(*) FROM wl WHERE staff_purchase_flag
UNION ALL SELECT 'status_cancelled_with_lines', count(DISTINCT receipt_id), sum(net_amount), count(*) FROM wl WHERE status IN ('cancelled','processing')

WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 1 AS first_period, 3 AS last_period
),
period_range AS (
    SELECT MIN(calendar_date) AS start_date, MAX(calendar_date) AS end_date
    FROM dim_date d, params p
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = p.fiscal_year AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN p.first_period AND p.last_period
),
sale_lines AS (
    SELECT f.receipt_id, f.net_amount,
           CASE WHEN s.store_id = 900
                THEN CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)
                ELSE f.sale_date END AS recognised_date,
           CASE WHEN s.store_id = 900 THEN 'web' ELSE 'stores' END AS part
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id AND s.store_id = 900
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999
      AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
      AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 1 AS first_period, 3 AS last_period,
       COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id) AS receipts,
       ROUND(SUM(net_amount), 2) AS net_sales_before_returns,
       ROUND(SUM(net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id), 2) AS atv,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN part='web' THEN receipt_id END) AS web_receipts,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN part='stores' THEN net_amount END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN part='stores' THEN receipt_id END), 2) AS atv_stores_only,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN part='web' THEN net_amount END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN part='web' THEN receipt_id END), 2) AS atv_web_only
FROM sale_lines, period_range r
WHERE recognised_date BETWEEN r.start_date AND r.end_date

WITH store_receipts AS (
    -- physical stores: dated by sale_date, staff purchases and test articles out
    SELECT 'stores' AS part, f.receipt_id, f.net_amount
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900
      AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
      AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
),
web_receipts AS (
    -- web shop (store 900): recognised on the Helsinki dispatch date, cancelled and processing orders have no lines
    SELECT 'web' AS part, f.receipt_id, f.net_amount
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900
      AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
      AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
),
all_receipts AS (
    SELECT * FROM store_receipts UNION ALL SELECT * FROM web_receipts
)
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 1 AS first_period, 3 AS last_period,
       COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id) AS receipts,
       ROUND(SUM(net_amount), 2) AS net_sales_before_returns,
       ROUND(SUM(net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id), 2) AS atv,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN part='web' THEN receipt_id END) AS web_receipts,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN part='stores' THEN net_amount END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN part='stores' THEN receipt_id END), 2) AS atv_stores_only,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN part='web' THEN net_amount END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN part='web' THEN receipt_id END), 2) AS atv_web_only
FROM all_receipts
